question: €10,000 grows at 6% a year for 30 years; a 1% yearly fee cuts that to 5%. What share of the final pot is lost, in percent?
move: Judge a yearly fee by what it removes over decades, not one year.
ask: Do I know the yearly fee on my pension or savings, and what it adds up to?
trap: Thinking a 1% fee costs about 1% of the money.
hint: Grow the money at both rates, then compare the two endings.

items.label: Same pot with a 1% yearly fee

diagram.caption: A 1% yearly fee takes about a quarter of what €10,000 grows to in 30 years.

reference: Effect of a 1% annual fee over 30 years, worked arithmetic, 2026
